# Taskboard filtering specification — revision 2

## FILTER-001: Deadline boundary
`select_tasks(..., due_on_or_before="YYYY-MM-DD")` returns tasks whose deadline
is on or before the cutoff. The boundary is inclusive. A task due exactly on
the cutoff date must be included; a task due later must be excluded.
Parse calendar dates, not string prefixes. This also applies on leap days.

## FILTER-002: Missing deadlines
Tasks with no deadline are excluded when a cutoff is supplied. Without a cutoff,
undated tasks remain eligible. Invalid date values raise ValueError.

## FILTER-003: Compatibility
`status` is optional and accepts `open` or `done`; any other value raises ValueError.
`limit` is optional and is applied after filtering. Zero means an empty result;
negative values, booleans and non-integers are rejected. Input records must not
be modified, and returned records must be independent shallow copies.

## FILTER-004: Result ordering
Preserve input order; do not sort the result by deadline.

## FILTER-005: Compound filters
Apply the inclusive deadline and status filters before limit; an eligible task on the cutoff consumes a result slot.

"""Target tests: the inclusive deadline boundary is the requested behavior."""
import pytest
from tasks import select_tasks


@pytest.mark.parametrize("cutoff", ["2026-11-14", "2024-02-29", "2026-12-31"])
def test_deadline_includes_the_cutoff_date(cutoff):
    tasks = [
        {"id": "earlier", "status": "open", "due_date": "2024-01-01"},
        {"id": "boundary", "status": "open", "due_date": cutoff},
        {"id": "later", "status": "open", "due_date": "2027-01-01"},
        {"id": "undated", "status": "open", "due_date": None},
    ]
    assert [t["id"] for t in select_tasks(tasks, due_on_or_before=cutoff)] == ["earlier", "boundary"]


def test_inclusive_deadline_combines_with_status_and_limit_in_original_order():
    tasks = [
        {"id": "boundary", "status": "open", "due_date": "2026-11-14"},
        {"id": "done", "status": "done", "due_date": "2026-11-13"},
        {"id": "earlier", "status": "open", "due_date": "2026-11-12"},
    ]
    assert [t["id"] for t in select_tasks(tasks, status="open", due_on_or_before="2026-11-14", limit=1)] == ["boundary"]
